note: The session's shared web-search allowance ran out early in this part, so most leads came from pages read directly: the Colorado Judicial Branch's own judge pages, the Secretary of State's 2022 Directory of Office Holders (district and county judges, with each judge's date of oath and term), the Denver County Court's Judicial Officers page, Law Week Colorado's appointment notices, and the parties' own candidate pages (used only to find campaign sites, which were then opened and checked). The Office of Judicial Performance Evaluation's site (judicialperformance.colorado.gov) answers 403 and was not used. Candidates with nothing found are listed with no findings.
verifier_note: Every url re-opened on 2026-10-02 with the kit's User-Agent; all 22 pages answered. All 32 findings confirmed. One correction: Michael Clarkson's own_words quote was cut to its party statement, leaving out his line of work.
